samples.xml_description:
<module id="right_shifter">
    <description>Initialize the q register to 0 and shift its contents to the right by one bit on each rising edge of the clock. Insert the new input bit d into the most significant position of the register.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="d">Input.</input>
        <output id="q" width_description="[7:0]">Output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="STATE_0" value="0">State 0.</enum>
        <enum id="STATE_1" value="1">State 1.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="q" type="reg" width="8">8-bit register.</reg>
        <always>
            <case>
                <when>
                    <condition>clk</condition>
                    <statement>q <= (q >> 1);</statement>
                </when>
            </case>
        </always>
        <always>
            <case>
                <when>
                    <condition>clk</condition>
                    <statement>q[7] <= d;</statement>
                </when>
            </case>
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <task>
        <description>Initialize q to 0.</description>
        <sequence>
            <assign>
                <left>q</left>
                <right>8'b00000000</right>
            </assign>
        </sequence>
    </task>
</module>
